pattern: Before reusing an exceptional-set theorem inside a quantitative scale-critical consumer, separate count/location control from the consumer's level-dependent modulus and test the modulus explicitly.
trigger_signature: finite exceptional set or bounded number of centers
downstream consumer requires radius/scale depending on a threshold
local regularity must glue over a noncompact domain
recommended_falsifier: ask for the exact threshold-to-distance/radius inequality in the source proof; absence blocks direct transfer
non_guarantees: does not prove a modulus is impossible
does not replace source-specific PDE analysis
